== 2014 Holotable image ==
[[File:VB8-L-narshaddaa-pre.gif|thumb|Block 8 face distributed by Holotable in December 2014]]
The December 2014 Holotable Set 0 folder carried the full Block 8 face. The Light Side control condition and Dark Side react wording match the printed versions. The Holotable CDF has a wording discrepancy independent of the image.<ref>[http://www.holotable.com/download/downloads/holotable-large_images_postreset.tar.bz2 Holotable post-reset image archive], December 2014, member <code>cards/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/narshaddaa.gif</code>.</ref>

== Early Set 0 sheet ==
The 2014 sheet gives the same controller conditions and actions on both sides as the August 2016 sheet.<ref>Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Set 0], official text as of 1 August 2016, page 12.</ref>

== Publication history ==
The August 2016 Set 0 slip and the retained 2018 full-card image agree on both sides.
